resources.string: Its readings and per-app usage are deleted with it. Daily totals stay as they are.
It was deleted, or history retention removed it.
The charge counter covered %1$s%% of this session.
Recorded by an older version, so drain wasn\'t measured.

A session is one stretch of the same power state: on battery, charging, or plugged in. It ends when that changes, when monitoring stops or misses readings, or when you reset the numbers on Now.

Used and Charged come from the battery's charge counter, over the time it reported. Average is that charge spread over the same time.

Capacity is the full capacity this session's charge points to. Health combines it with other sessions.
No readings are linked to this session.

Screen on and screen off count only time on battery. The first number is the average drain per hour as a share of the battery\'s full capacity; mA is the same drain as current.\n\nDeep sleep is how much of the time the processor was fully asleep. With the screen off it should be high: if it is low, something kept the phone awake.

Average power is the energy added divided by the time the charge counter reported; peak is the highest reading while monitoring.\n\nThe 20 to 80 time is how long the level took to climb from 20 to 80 percent. It shows when the session covered both.
Since Android reset its stats, during this session
Since the last full charge (no comparable reading at unplug)
Per-app usage is read when you plug in.
No per-app usage: Voltwise had no Shizuku, root or ADB access when the phone was plugged in. Shizuku without root stops when the phone restarts; open Shizuku to start it again.
No per-app usage: monitoring stopped before the phone was plugged in, or Android\'s stats couldn\'t be read.
No per-app usage was recorded for this session.
No app used measurable power in this session.

Voltwise reads Android's per-app battery stats when you unplug and again when you plug in; each app's number is the difference. If Android reset its stats in between, the totals since the reset are shown. Without a reading at unplug, the totals since the last full charge are shown instead.

Reading these stats needs Shizuku, root or ADB access. Shizuku without root stops when the phone restarts: open Shizuku to start it again.

The values are Android's estimates. One entry can cover several apps that share an ID.
